pattern: Embodied cognition (Varela et al., 1991): Cognition emerges from dynamic sensorimotor coupling between agent and environment, not internal computation alone. For AI design: projections must create structural coupling loops where operator feedback changes agent behavior; minimal viable embodiment works via CLI first before hardware dependencies; ambient presence blurs agent-environment boundary rather than reinforcing Cartesian dualism.

Projection systems fail external-subject rule when they become one-way status displays. Must implement closed-loop interaction: agent emits projection → operator notices/responds → agent adjusts based on response. Success = operator reports noticing without consciously checking; failure = operator ignores projection as background noise or treats it as dashboard to monitor.
